description: 阿尔宾反弃兵 D08 — 练习（高级综合）：黑方主动弃兵，白方如何应对？

intro.popup_en:
Gambit Initiative, Practice 10 (Advanced Review)
The final test: in a 1.d4 opening, Black offers the e-pawn with the Albin Countergambit. You accept, and Black advances to d4 with a strong threat. Is the gambit sound? How should White respond accurately, and what happens if White misplays?
intro.popup:
弃兵争先 练习10（高级综合）

10课学习之旅的最终考验！

阿尔宾反弃兵：
d4开局，黑方第2手主动送e5！

但这次你是白方——
你接受了黑方的弃兵……

现在黑方走d4！威胁很大！

综合练习：
① 黑方弃兵成立吗？（三要素检验）
② 白方接受弃兵后如何精确应对？
③ 白方如果应对不当，黑方的威胁是什么？

outro.popup_en: Black's Albin Countergambit has semi-open-file potential, rapid development, and a strong d4 wedge as its target, so it is playable but ambitious. White can neutralize it with e3, directly challenging the wedge. The overall lesson: gambits trade material for time. The giver must secure enough compensation; the accepter must defend precisely. A mistake by either side can change the evaluation sharply.
outro.popup:
高级综合总结

阿尔宾反弃兵评估（黑方）：
① 开放线路——d线/e线均有半开放可能
② 发展领先——黑方快速出子
③ 进攻目标——d4强兵，白方中心被楔入！

⭐ 结论：黑方弃兵勉强成立！
但白方正确应对（e3！）可以化解

白方正确处理d4楔兵的方法：
e3！直接挑战d4，不让黑方坐享其成

最终10课总结：
弃兵争先 = 速度的买卖
买家（送兵方）：确保补偿够用
卖家（接受方）：确保防守精确
任何一方判断失误——优劣立判！

moves.popup_en: d4! White begins building a broad center.
c4! The Queen's Gambit setup gives White a powerful c4-d4 center.
moves.popup:
c4！后翼弃兵体系
白方c4+d4超强中心

moves.popup_en: ...e5!! The Albin Countergambit. Black actively offers a pawn. As White, test the offer: will the d-file open, will Black gain development time, and what is Black's attacking target?
moves.popup:
e5！！阿尔宾反弃兵！

黑方主动弃兵！！

⭐ 你是白方——要吃吗？
用三要素检验黑方的弃兵：
① 如果你吃了，d线开放了吗？
② 黑方发展比你快吗？
③ 黑方有什么进攻目标？

让我们继续看……

moves.popup_en: dxe5 accepts the gambit. White wins a pawn on e5, but it may be difficult to hold. What threat should White anticipate?
moves.popup:
dxe5 白方接受弃兵

白方多了一个e5兵
但这个兵很难守……

⭐ 现在该注意什么？

moves.popup_en: ...d4!! Black's key threat: the pawn from d5 advances to d4. It threatens ...d3 to tear open White's position, forces White to spend time responding, and attacks the c4-pawn.
moves.popup:
d4！！黑方的威胁来了！

⭐ 关键局面！
黑方把d5兵推到d4——
这是阿尔宾反弃兵的核心！

d4楔兵的威胁：
① d4-d3！撕裂白方阵型
② 要求白方花步应对
③ 白方c4兵被d4攻击！

moves.popup_en: e3! The accurate response directly challenges the d4 wedge. If ...dxe3, Bxe3 removes the wedge; if the pawn remains, e3 reinforces White's structure. By contrast, after Nf3 Black can play ...d3 and break open the position.
moves.popup:
e3！白方正确的应对！

⭐ 为什么e3是关键？

e3直接挑战d4楔兵！
如果dxe3，白方Bxe3，d4消失，白方OK
如果d4继续待着，e3守住阵型

反面教材：如果白方走Nf3？
黑方d3！直接炸开白方阵型！

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and continues to pressure e5. Black develops a piece instead of advancing the d-pawn again, confirming that e3 has neutralized the immediate threat.
moves.popup:
Nc6！黑方发展马，继续施压e5

黑方用了一步发展来替代继续推d4
这说明e3有效挡住了d4威胁！

moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops. White has developed three pieces while Black has developed one; despite giving a pawn, Black has not gained a true lead in development.
moves.popup:
Nf3！发展马！

⭐ 白方现在节拍：
白方：d4+c4+e5+e3+Nf3（3枚子）
黑方：d5+e5+d4+Nc6（1枚子）

发展上白方领先！
黑方送了弃兵，节拍没有真正领先……

moves.popup_en: ...Bb4+! Black gives check with a developing move, hoping to gain a tempo.
moves.popup:
Bb4+！黑方送出将军！

又是这个手段——
用发展来将军，占便宜！

moves.popup_en: Bd2! White blocks with development, both answering the check and preparing to exchange the bishop. Every move remains useful.
moves.popup:
Bd2！白方象发展挡将！

⭐ 双重目的：
① 挡住Bb4+的将军
② 象到d2，准备下一步兑换
白方精确应对，每步都有效率！

moves.popup_en: ...dxe3 finally exchanges the wedge. The d4-pawn can no longer advance, so Black captures on e3.
moves.popup:
dxe3 黑方终于兑换！

d4楔兵不能再继续了
黑方在这一刻兑换e3

moves.popup_en: Bxb4! White exchanges off the active bishop and prepares to recapture on e3 with either fxe3 or Nxe3.
moves.popup:
Bxb4！白方顺手兑换Bb4！

⭐ 同时完成两件事：
① 消灭了对黑方有用的活跃象
② 为fxe3或Nxe3做准备

moves.popup_en: ...Nxb4 recaptures, and the position begins to settle.
moves.popup:
Nxb4 黑方马夺回

局面趋于平稳……

moves.popup_en: fxe3! White recaptures. White has strong pawns on e3 and e5 with coordinated pieces; Black's knights are active, but the gambit has been neutralized. Evaluate the countergambit with the three criteria: was it sound, why was e3 more accurate than Nf3, and what should White examine first against a future d4 wedge?
moves.popup:
fxe3！白方兵夺回e3

⭐ 最终局面评估：
白方：e3+e5双强兵，子力协调
黑方：Nc6+Nb4活跃，但弃兵已经被化解

⭐ 高级综合练习问题：

① 黑方的e5弃兵成立了吗？
用三要素给出你的判断！

② 白方最关键的一步是哪步？
为什么e3比Nf3好那么多？

③ 如果你下次遇到d4体系的反弃兵
你会优先看什么？
